tei:div.tei:p: pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pas gtso mdzad pa'i sku 'khor thams cad kyi mngon sum du mthong grub la byung bas/ rje btsun nyid la ltas ya mtshan can 'di rnams kyi rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ rje btsun nyid kyi zhal nas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sman gyi mchod pa bla na med pa yin no// zhes gsung zhing gnas bstod ngo mtshar can yang mdzad do// yang dus skabs shig la chab tshan la phebs rjes sku grib la brten pa'i gnyan 'brum gyi rnam pa gcig sku la byung ba la brten pa'i zla ba phyed gnyis tsam shin tu mnyel tshul bstan pa'i mthar/ gzim chung na thugs dam gtor ma mdzad grub rjes/ sku ngal ba zhig gi skabs sku zur g.yas phyogs kyi ka gdong gsol lcog bsgrigs pa'i steng na/ yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku yongs su rdzogs pa byis pa lo bdun pa'i tshad tsam yod pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa| dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' 'ja' ris su bzhes pa zhig 'dug pa/ gzigs ma thag nyams kyi snang ba yin dgongs nas/ chags zhen 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral ba nyid kyi sku dang dbyer med pa snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pa'i ngang nas/ yang sku zur g.yon gyi ka gdong na/ bu mo shin tu mdzes shing lang tsho dar la babs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig yi dam dngos kyi cha lugs su bzhugs pa'i gsung gis/ mos gus gsol btab mdzad nas kyang*/ dbang bzhi bzhes par mi spro'am/ zhes gsung byung dus sku shed kyi ma lcogs bzhin pa'i ngang nas phyag gi nem nem mdzad pas/ snang la rdos bcas kyi rang bzhin du ma grub par 'ja' lus su 'dug pas/ mos gus dang dag snang khyad par can 'khrungs te/ dbang bzhi ka yongs su rdzogs par blangs nas/ de ka'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas/ snyung gzhi ni de ka'i mod la rang sangs la song 'dug lus sems la sngon chad med pa'i bskyed rim gyi gsal nyams/ 'dzin med kyi stong nyams/

zag med kyi bde nyams/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi rtogs pa sngar las khyad par du gyur pa thugs las 'khrungs te/ rdo rje theg pa'i zab don dbang bzhi'i don mthar thug pa dus 'di nas mngon du gyur pa yin no// de ltar lung ston pa'i bu mo de ni/ rdo rje phag mo dngos rang yin par thugs yid ches nas/ zhal gnyis ma'i chog sgrigs de yang rje btsun mas bskul nas dar rgyas su mdzad do// 'di lta bu'i tshul 'di ni dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mos zhal dang dngos su bstan pa la/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyis/ smin byed dbang bzhi zhus nas grol byed lam bzhi'i rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs te/ sku bzhi mngon du gyur pa'i mdzad pa mthar thug pa mchog tu gyur pa yin no// de dag gi don ni/ rje nyid kyi thugs dam nyams len rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pas/ rtsa dbu ma'i mdud pa rang sar grol ba'i nang du/ rlung sems khams dkar dmar dang bcas pa dbyer med du 'dres pas/ zag med kyi bde ba chen po'i rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs pa'i nus pa ye shes dag pa'i 'char sgo la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi zhal mngon sum du bstan pa la/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus pas sku bzhi mngon du gyur pa yin no// de dag gi don smras pa/ 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon kun dga'i mtshan can de// zab don dbang bzhi'i don la legs sbyangs pas// mdud bral dbu ma chos kyi pho brang der// rlung sems thig le dbyer med 'dres pa'i mthus// ye shes 'gag med bde chen rol pa'i gar// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la// dngos su dbang nos lam bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes// sku bzhi tshe gcig 'grub pa khyod nyid tsam// snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gi sprul sku kun dga' rin chen gyi// zhabs pad brtan cing mos pas gsol 'debs rnams// yongs 'dzin 'di 'dras rjes bzung blo re bde// gdung shugs drag pos snying nas gsol ba thob// byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med// ces pa ni rje nyid kyi 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la dngos su dbang bzhi zhus pas sku bzhi mngon du gyur pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// ti sgror sku mtshams grol nas/

dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa 'dren gyi bar la/ zhing khams gzhan gyi gdul bya la dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung sgros nges pa can phebs tshul ni/ phyogs kyi dad 'dus mnga' ris dang*/ dbus gtsang dang*/ dwags kong dang*/ mdo khams la sogs pa nas| bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rnal 'byor pho mo la sogs pa dad 'dus kyi gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'tshogs pa rnams la/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas drang nges kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dbyar chos dang dgun chos la sogs pa zab cing rgya che ba gsungs so// de'i tshe chos ra nam 'tshogs dus su/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs nan gyis rgyas par gsung ba dang*/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ khyad par snying po'i nyams len bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la rang res kyang lag rjes che ba zhig rang dgos rgyu yin te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgra mang ba ltar cung zad dka' tsam byung*/ de ni spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas par dka'/ sgos zab chos nyams su len pa nyung*/ khyad par dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa lta bu yang 'chad mkhan dkon/ rang re lta bu yang rgyun ring sdod pa'i chos can min pas/ brgya bshad stong bshad byas kyang don rtsa nyams len la 'bung dgos pa yin no// zhes zhing khams gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung dang*/ thugs skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi mdangs yod pa'i bka' lung*| bu slob rnams nyams len la skul ba'i zhal bkod yang yang gnang gin 'dug dus/ chos nyan gyi grwa bu slob dbang rnon kha re nang phan tshun/ rje rin po che'i gsung 'byon lugs 'di/ zhing gzhan du myur bar 'byon pa'i gsung rigs 'dra yang don la dpe med las che snyam pa'i ngang nas/ nang phan tshun cung zad gleng ba dang*| bla ma dang bral dogs pa'i gdung ba drag po dang*/ sems khong du chud pa'i skyo shas kyi ngang nas mig mchi mas gang zhing ngag tu shugs ring 'byin par byed do// chos nyan phal cher ni/

rje btsun rin po che zhing gzhan du 'byon pa'i gsung nges pa can ni ma go/ las 'bras la yid ches dgos tshul dang*/ tshe la long med pas zab don nyams len la 'bung dgos tshul gyi gsung sgros khyad pa can rnams rang rgyud la 'byor bas der 'dus pa thams cad 'khor ba la skyo zhing nges par 'byung ba'i ngang nas don gyi nyams len la brtson zhing thugs dam la bogs thon pa yin no// de ltar zhing khams gzhan du 'byon pa'i gsung sgros shugs 'byung la/ chos ra dang bzhugs gral sogs gang phebs su gsungs kyang*/ rjes la go ba ma gtogs de dus zhing gzhan du 'byon par ma go ba sha stag yin no// yang skabs shig tu/ dus 'khrugs tsho la brten pa'i thugs nges par 'byung zhing*/ zhing gzhan du 'byon pa'i gsung sgros chos ra sogs su shugs 'byung la/ gsung mgur gyi tshul du 'di gsungs so// spyir 'khor ba skyid med sdug bsngal rang bzhin la// bye brag snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye dgu rnams// bsod nams phyogs re gang la'ang yid brtan med// bde skyid snang ba byis pa'i rtse dga' 'dra// mi rtag 'gyur ba tsho soms la lha chos gyis// bla ma yang yang du rnyed dka' gdams ngag long*// dam chos zab mo dang 'phrad dka' 'bungs la bsgom// dus ngan skye bo rnams 'dul dka' 'thab rtsod can// ban rgan skyu ra yang mi sdod 'gro snying 'dod// da ltar gsol ba re btab na phyi ma yang 'phrad// snyigs ma'i sems can tsho snying re rje na yang*// thub chen klu sgrub skyob pas grongs tshul bstan// ban rgan phung po nam 'dor cha med do// zhes pa la sogs pa'i thugs skyo shas kyi sgo nas gsung gzhug thung thung 'ba' zhig gsungs so// de nas rje btsun de nyid dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig pa bya lo'i dus kyi tshe| gangs ri'i khrod kyi mchod sdong chen po/ rten mchog bkra shis sgo mang legs par grub nas nang bzhugs kyi dus la bab pa'i tshe/

thog mar bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi gsang mtshan grangs mang sngon po gser gyi bris pa po ti longs pa du ma dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang rgya bod kyi bla ma paṇa grub tshad ldan rnams kyi ring bsrel sogs ngo mtshar che ba byin rlabs can mang po dang*/ de nas rim pa bzhin/ bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i rten byin rlabs can mang po dang*| gzungs sngags byin rlabs can/ stod smad bar gsum la 'jug par gsungs pa rnams dang*/ khyad par rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur tshang ma rnams go rim ma nor bar bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar can dang*/ grub chen yongs 'dzin khyad par can gyi dbu lo phyag sen la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang*/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bang mdzod dang*/ de thams cad kyi 'khrugs sel kyi gzungs du ma dang*/ rin po che sna lnga la sogs rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ 'bru sna lnga dang*/ sman sna lnga dang*/ ja gos dar dang*/ mngar gsum dang*/ dkar gsum dang*/ lha dang mi'i zas sna la sogs pa dpag tu med pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par rje btsun 'di nyid kyi dbu lo dang phyag sen dang*/ na bza' gsol spyad cha tshang la sogs te/ gzungs gzhug gi khyad par mdo rgyud nas ji ltar gsungs pa las/ gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa'i rim pa mthong ba brgyud pa las ji ltar byung ba bzhin mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa mdzad pa yin no// de ltar gzungs gzhug legs par grub pa'i rten 'di nyid la rab tu gnas pa rgya chen po mdzad pa'i gtso bo rje btsun rin po che 'di nyid kyis mdzad do// dge slong gi dge 'dun snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan thogs pa brgya stong mang pos thog drangs te dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bus/ gza' skar gyi 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ me tog 'thor ba'i dus su/

lha dang mkha' 'gros me tog gi char chen pos nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar byas te/ lding zhing 'bab par gyur/ ri bo'i ngos kun kyang 'ja' tshon gyis drwa bas chod par gyur/ bar snang las rol mo'i sgra snyan yang 'byung bar gyur| sa gzhi thams cad dri bzang gis ngad pas khyab par gyur to// de ltar phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rgya chen po'i ngang nas/ rgyal ba rnams kyi mdo rgyud las ji ltar gsungs pa ltar rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i dus su/ ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs pa'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa byung zhing*/ blo mig dag pa rnams kyi mngon sum du ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs 'ja' 'od kyi rnam par bar snang gi tshogs gang bar byon nas/ rten bkra shis sgo mang la thim par gyur pa'i mod la/ rten gsum rnams las 'od zer gyi phreng ba brgya stong du ma 'phros shing 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad 'od zer chen pos khyab par mthong ngo*// de nas chos bzang lha'i mdun sa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi la 'gran par nus pa'i gral chen gyi bkod pa mdzad nas/ ro brgya ldan pa'i zas sna'i bye brag dpag tu med pa rnams kyi bsnyen bkur bzang po phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du/ yon gyi khyad par dpon mo che pas thog drangs rnams la rim bzhin du bcud kyis gang ba'i gan dkar gyis thog drangs gser spyad dang dngul spyad cha yongs su rdzogs pa dang ri mo'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i kha btags dang*/ deng phon za 'og la sogs pa gos dar gyi yug bzang zhing mdog mdzes pa brgya phrag du ma dang*/ lu hang la sogs pa'i rgyu bzang mchog tu gyur pa'i na bza' cha tshang ba dang*/ shin tu bzang ba'i rta mchog dang dre'u rab tu mang po dang*/ gser dngul g.yu mu tig la sogs pa lha dang mi'i rin po che'i rnam grangs du ma'i tshogs dang*/ ja sig brgya phrag tu longs pa bzang zhing ngad pa 'thul ba dag dang*/

gzhan yang mdzo pho mo/ go khrab/ zangs spyad la sogs te sa gzhi thams cad gang zhing khyab par gyur pa yin no// me tog 'thor ba'i bla ma che dgu sogs tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu thams cad la'ang*/ skabs thob kyi gnang sbyin dang bcas te/ mdor na rnam thos kyi bu'i dpal 'byor zil gyis gnon nus pa'i gnang sbyin gyi tshogs rnams kyis skye dgu thams cad lugs gnyis kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bkod pa 'di yang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa rlabs po che nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bla na med pa 'gro ba'i mig lam du bstan pa yang mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam par thar pa yin no// de ltar rje 'gro ba'i mgon po skyob pa kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa la thugs stobs shin tu che zhing thugs bzhed ji ltar yod pa bzhin/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rtsol med du grogs mdzad cing*/ dngos su bka' lung dang du len pa'i zhabs 'bring ba skye ba dpag tu med pa nas rje nyid kyi phrin las bsgrub par smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar ba'i skyes mchog ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i tshad med pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa/ ma rungs pa tshar gcod pa'i dpa' bo chen po/ dpal mi'i dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan de nyid kyis/ rje rgyal ba'i dbang po'i dgongs bzhed rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa| dpon blon gyi tshul bzung nas dngos su sgrub tshul bsam gyis mi khyab la khyad par thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang sngar yod rnams las/ rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba lha grangs mang ba bzo khyad mchog tu gyur pa yongs su rdzogs par grub pa ni/ sbrul lo nas dbu btsugs nas/ bya lo ston zla ra ba'i skabs der grub pa yin no// 'di nyid legs par sgrub pa'i khur gyi gtso bo/ mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsnams nas/ tshad med pa'i dka' ba dang du blangs te/

rje btsun nyid kyi dgongs pa ji ltar yod pa bzhin bsgrubs pa yin no// de nas dpon mo che 'khor bcas thams cad kyang*/ rje nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsis smin par mdzad de/ gser gdugs kyi bka' bkod kyang dang du blangs te/ rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin cing*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi myong ba'i smon lam rgya chen po btab ste rang rang gi gnas su dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te sleb nas| gnyen bshes kyi tshogs thams cad dbul ba dang bral bar byas so// thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs tshul la ngo mtshar dad pas tshigs su bcad de smras pa| rgyal ba'i rnam sprul kun dga' rin chen gyi// thugs dam rten mchog tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i zhing*// khams gsum rin chen ma lus spungs pa'i ri// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha yi gzhal yas khang*// dus gsum rgyal ba rgyal sras lha yi tshogs// sum stong bcu phrag lnga yi grong khyer mchog /'gro kun tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i rten gcig pu// ngo mtshar mchog gyur bkra shis sgo mang 'di// rje btsun nyid kyi thugs rje'i dpal las grub// 'di yi phyogs su longs spyod btang ba dang*// sgo gsum gus pas dad cing mos pa dang*// bya ba byed dang rjes su yi rang dang*// rgyu rkyen 'dres dang 'bad pa byas pa sogs// gnas skabs tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing*| |phyi ma byang chub thob par rgyal bas gsungs// rje btsun 'di 'dras rjes su bzung ba yi// skye 'gro thams cad dal 'byor snying po lon// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par the tshom med// de phyir dga' bar gyis la gsol ba thob// ces so// de ltar 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa rigs rus cho 'brang gi mngon par mtho ba/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad kyi rtse mor son zhing*/

'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar byed pa'i ded dpon chen po 'dis/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la gus pa rlabs po che'i sgo nas sri zhu'i rim pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur rab 'byams lha'i 'khor lo ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sku gzugs kyi bye brag bkra shis sgo mang don gnyis lhun grub tu stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i dgongs pa mthar phyin te/ ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'di nyid la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul ba'i ngang nas| phyogs kyi dad 'dus dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhugs so// de'i tshe/ dad 'dus kyi bu slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus pa'i nang nas gtso che ba 'ga' zhig smos pa ni 'di lta ste/ jo gdan pa'i mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor ba dang*/ gling gi du si ting 'dzin 'od zer ba dang*/ chos sgo ba'i khur 'dzin pa ngag gi dbang po zhes pa dang*/ smin grol gyi mnga' bdag gangs dkar ras chen pa dang*/ khra ba kha'i gdan sa ba mkhas grub bsod nams rgya mtsho ba dang*| mkhas btsun chen po bya yul spyan snga chos grags rgyal mtshan dang*/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'chad ka ba'i spyan snga dang*/ rab 'byams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chen po rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ mtshungs med don grub rgyal gyi sku skye kun dga' rgya mtsho zhes pa dang*/ sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po kun dga' rgya mtsho zhes pa dang*/ bshes gnyen dam pa bka' bcu smra ba'i dbang po smon lam dpal dang*/ mkhas grub chen po rin chen rgya mtsho ba dang*/ gzhan yang rtsod med kyi grub chen zur mang chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho ba dang*/ stag lung pa'i mkhan slob chos gsum dang*/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i chos rje rin chen dang*/ ti se'i rdor 'dzin mgon po ye shes zhes pa dang*/

dpal ldan blo gros zhes pa dang*/ la phyi'i rdor 'dzin blo gros dpal ldan pa dang*/ rdor 'dzin kun dga' rdo rje zhes pa dang*/ tsā ri rdor 'dzin bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sogs te/ gnas gsum gangs ri'i rdor 'dzin chen po rnams dang*/ mdor na stod kyi kha che nas| smad kyi rgya'i 'khor sa yan chad kyi bar na yod pa'i dbus gtsang la sogs pa'i che btsun dang*/ dge bshes dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis rje btsun 'di nyid kyi zhabs la gtugs shing the tshom sgro 'dogs thams cad bcad nas/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi gnas gsum la sogs te/ g.ya' khrod dang gangs khrod la sogs pa bzung nas/ 'ga' zhig gis ni tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu skyong ba'i 'gro don/ 'ga' zhig gis ni tshe sgrub pa snyoms pa'i nyams len/ 'ga' zhig gis ni| lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi sgrub pa/ thams cad kyang dbyar mtshams dgun mtshams la sogs pa'i sgo nas sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pas/ rje btsun 'di nyid rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang gnyis pa lta bur gyur pa'o// yang dus skabs dang*/ bka' rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa la yang*| sngar nas smin grol la bkod pa'i steng du/ sgom zhwa bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya sogs rten 'brel gnang sbyin dang bcas pa mdzad nas/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa sgos bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' lung zhib rgyas su gnang ba la sogs te/ dus rtag tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig la 'jug par mdzad do// gzhan yang rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po 'di nyid kyis/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhal gzigs nas| chos dngos su gsan pa dang*/ chos skyong gi phrin las rtsol med du sgrub pa dang*/ sde brgyad dang mi ma yin bran du 'khol ba dang*/ sngon mkhyen dang grub rtags dpag tu med pa ston nus pa sogs sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang*/

phal cher ni shin tu gsang ba'i tshul gyis sbed pa kho na rang mdzad pa yin zhing*/ sku tshe'i stod la so so skye bo'i mig lam du cung zad rig pa rnams ni/ sngar gong du bstan pa ltar zur tsam bstan pa yin la/ sku tshe'i smad la mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ mthu stobs dang rdu 'phrul gyi nus pas bdud dang log 'dren tshar bcad cing zil gyis mnan pa'i tshul ni| las dag pa'i sku 'khor rnams kyi cha zur tsam rig pa mdor bsdus tsam brjod na/ bla ma 'bri gung ras chen pa de nyid/ dus nam zhig gi tshe 'brum bu snyung te/ rdo ra dkar mor sbra phub nas dpon slob 'ga' bzhugs dus/ snyung zug shin tu che zhing thugs rab tu 'khrug pa'i gzigs snang la/ 'dug sa'i sa gzhi thams cad chus gang ba/ nam mkha' mes khyab pa/ bar snang mun nag 'khrigs pa'i dkyil du/ gshin rje'i gzugs sna tshogs pas mtshon thogs nas/ ya nga ba'i ltas sna tshogs pas sdigs shing*/ de dang dus mnyam par/ dpon slob kun gyi shangs lam du/ gseb dri rgyal lhog lhog byung ba'i tshe/ dbu mang po rtsegs pa'i shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs shig mthong byung ma thag dang por dgongs pa la 'jigs byed red snyam pa'i snang ba byung ba la/ gzugs brnyan de ni dbu dgu po sba ba dgu byas pa'i mdog sngo skya thal ba'i mdog can zhig gis bgrad mig dang*/ mi sdug pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po bstan byung ba la/ thugs dran med du 'gro tshad pa la/ a tsa ma sems can thams cad la| 'di lta bu'i bdud kyi sdug bsngal zhing 'jigs pa bskyed par byed pa 'di/ snying re rje snyam pa'i snying rje tshad med pa thugs las 'khrungs te/ sdug bsngal 'di las thar bar byed pa la/ rje la gsol ba 'debs pa las thabs gzhan med snyam nas/ rje nyid la mos gus tshad bzung med pa zhig skyes nas| gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ skad cig de nyid la mdun gyi nam mkhar/

rje de nyid khri bkod pa mchog dang ldan pa'i steng du/ sku la snam sbyar dmar ser nyis brtsegs dang*/ dbu la sgom zhwa bzhes pa'i gsung gis/ bu bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab na nad las myur du grol bar 'gyur ro// rang gi lan chags 'khor ba'i phyir du 'byung po la rang lus las bton pa'i khrag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma byin cig 'jigs rgyu med do gsungs te/ sku nam mkhar yal te mi snang bar gyur to// dus der thugs sos pa'i dran pa rnyed de/ nyams bzang po shar/ rang lus gtar ba'i khrag gi gtor ma bsngos pas/ bgegs de rlung dmar zhig tu gyur nas gzhu rong mdar thon nas song ngo*// der ras chen pa'i thugs la/ nga'i bla ma dam pa 'di/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon dngos rang yin nges so snyam nas mos gus lhag par skyes te/ bka' drin 'khor med ma'i gsol 'debs de yang dus der mdzad cing*/ rje nyid kyi lung bstan pa ltar nad las myur du grol ba yin no// yang ye shes mgon pos 'bral med du phrin las sgrub pa'i rtags ni/ sku zur g.yas g.yon du bya rog shin tu snum pa gnyis yang yang du gzigs pa dang*/ yang sku mtshams mdzad kha dang phyed thun gyi dus sku zur g.yas g.yon gyi stegs la/ khyi nag dang kha dkar ba spyi bo 'bur ba zhig rgyun du yong ba/ sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pas dngos su gzigs pa sogs shin tu mang ngo*// yang sgo mang bzhengs khar/ dpon mo che ba rnams dus thog la ma sleb pa la/ mi drag pa ngos chod gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas ye shes mgon po la gsol ba btab pas/ 'od gsal gyi gsal snang la/ mi gos dkar po gyon pa| lus kyi phyag tshad snyoms shing*/ yan lag rags la skra se 'bal le ba/ rgyan dang bcas pa lag na lcang rgyug bzung ba zhig na re/ bdag cag khyed kyi phrin las sgrub mkhan gyi bzo bo lags te/ zhag bdun la sleb pa byed zer ba byung bas/

da lan mi gtong mi dgos gsungs nas/ mi ma btang bas zhag bdun thog rang du sleb byung bas/ dbyibs dang cha lugs de rnams dpon mo che rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa rang du 'dug pa dang*/ lcang rgyug lam ngor 'dug cing*/ dpon mo che pa rnams chos skyong gis bkug pa thugs dam 'od gsal gyi gzigs lam du phebs pa yin no/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs mdzad dus kun yang*/ bzo rigs pa chos skyong gi bskul ba'i lo rgyus brjod kyis mi lang ba yod cing*/ khyad par sgo mang bzhengs dus byar pa dpon mo che ba rnams la chos skyong gi bskul ma byung tshul dkar chag na zur tsam yod do// yang sgo mang bzhengs pa'i skabs shig la/ 'byung po bdud rigs rnams kyis ma bzod par ngan sems phrag dog gi mtho brtsams te/ dpon mo che rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ sprul sku ngag dbang grags pa dang*/ phra ba dpon mo che ba rnams rim pas glo bur gyi nad drag pos btab nas rim gro sman dpyad gang gis kyang ma lhogs par tshe'i dus byed par nye ba'i skabs su/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyi thugs gnyis med ye shes chen po'i ngang nas/ 'byung po la gtor ma gnang*/ byams snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i mod la/ khong rnams nad drag po las myur du grol nas/ phyag 'bul la 'phral du sleb ste/ bzo la 'jug thub pa byung bas/ dpon mo che rnams/ rje nyid la mi brjed pa'i dad pa thob ste/ rje btsun nyid kyi bdud dang log 'dren zil gyis non cing chos skyong gi 'phrin las sgrub par yid ches nas bcos min gyi dad pa thob pa yin no// yang gsol ja ba gzungs dar 'chi ru nye ba'i nad kyis btab dus/ rje nyid kyis 'byung po la gtor ma zhig gnang nas/ bden stobs dang mgon po'i bka' bsgo gnang bas 'phral du bde ba kun gyi mthun grub du byung ba sogs nad pa drag po la/ byin rlabs bden stobs mdzad pa tsam gyis nad las grol ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/

brjod kyis mi lang ba yin no// gzhan yang sgrub sde'i chos khrims pa rin chen bshes gnyen bya ba/ 'go nad kyi rims drag pos btab ste/ 'chi bar thag chod nas 'chi bar rje btsun bla ma nyid dang ma mjal bar yid shin tu skyo zhing*/ zug gzer gyi bzod glags med par gyur pa'i tshe| rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can de/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dngos su phebs te 'chi kha dang bar do'i gdams ngag 'di gsungs so// bu rin chen bshes gnyen dad gus can/ khyod da lta nad kyis gdungs ba 'dis// tshe sngon gyi las sgrib 'dag par nges// da tshe 'di'i re ltos kun bor la// grogs skyel ma 'chi kha'i gdams ngag dang*// gnyen bsun ma bar do'i nyams len gnyis// pha bla mas da lta ston pa 'di// don nyams su longs la spro ba skyed// lus 'byung bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig dus 'dir// sgom 'od gsal 'char bas ma bu sprod// gshis 'dzin med phyag rgya chen por zhog /de ma shes 'gro la snying rje soms| |gnad 'di kas zung 'jug lam sna zin// 'di bar do dag pa'i gdams ngag ces// mgon rdo rje'i 'chang gi bka' bzhin du// yab skyu ra 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs// las ngan pa'i dbang gis gal te yang*// lus bar do'i snang ba 'char srid pas// sems skrag dngangs ma byed 'di ltar soms// skyon rnam smin phung po bor bas legs// skyabs bla ma yi dam bzhugs gnas su// grogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma 'ong*// 'od snang cha steng gi sbubs thag la// sems dran pas 'jus la lhug par zhog /pha bla ma'i gdams ngag 'chug mi srid// ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' 'di shin tu gnyan// bu da ltar ltung ba'i bshags sdom gyis// dbang bzhi rdzogs longs la lta ba skyongs// de legs par go 'am snying re rje// khyod ma 'jigs ma 'jigs bla mas skyob// skyabs bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyings dang*// bu lus ngag yid gsum ro gcig zhog

/ces gsung ba'i dus// de dag gi rgyu mtshan rnams nad g.yog pa rnams la bshad de/ kho rang thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bla ma'i snang ba dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas dbugs song ste/ bar do'i 'jigs skrag las grol nas lam sna zin pa yin no// gzhan yang nad pa rje la dad pa che ba dag 'chi khar 'bri gung rin po che'i drung du byang zhus thub pa gyis zer ba'i kha chems bzhag pa la shi dus/ rje btsun nyid kyi byang zhus gnang ba'i tshe| ngo mtshar ba'i ltas byung ba dang*/ yang byang zhus thub pas mi lus thob ste/ gzhon nu gtam smra shes tsam nyid nas/ rang gi skye ba dran te/ nged mi lus thob pa 'bri gung kun dga' rin chen la byang zhus thob pa'i bka' drin yin zhes pa bgrang gis mi lang ba byung ba da lta yang yod pa mngon sum du mthong zhing grub pa yin no// yang byang pa gcig gi byang shog bsregs pas/ shog gu la me rtsa ba nas ma 'bar bar/ byang zhus kyi phyag phyi ba rnams ci byed la thug pa la/ kho'i rnam shes gdon gdug pa can gyis 'dir ma btang bar 'dug dgongs nas/ thugs zag med kyi ting nge 'dzin ye shes kyi ngar dang ldan pas/ gshin po'i rnam shes gdon dang phral te gnas spar ba dang*/ gdon la snying rje drag po 'khrungs pa'i ngang nas phaṭa ces gsungs ma thag me 'bar zhing phyag g.yog pa rnams kyang shin tu skrag pa'i zil chen po dang bcas pa'i rjes la rig pa 'dzin med du cham me song 'dug rje btsun nyid ni da dung yang lta stangs ha re ba'i ngang la bzhugs 'dug go// phyis shi bo'i rnam shes gshed ma dang phral zhing gnas spar ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa yin no// gzhan yang 'ga' zhig 'chi ba'i dus byas te gnas pa la bsdad pa la/ rje nyid kyi byang bu'i sgrol chog gnang ma thag gnas pa las grol ba ni da lta mngon sum du mthong ba shin tu mang ba yin no// de lta bu la sogs pa mthong thos dran reg byang chub kyi lam la bkod pa'i mdzad pa rlabs po che bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ba yod na'ang*/

dad pa'i rten du cha zur tsam las/ shin tu gsang ba rnams bri bar ma spobs pa yin no// de nas khyi lo dpyid khar sleb dus/ thog ma med pa'i las ngan drag pos bskul te/ sngon rgya bod gang du yang mi srid pa'i 'byung po'i lhongs tshad| sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chags sgo la brten nas/ dge 'dun ma rungs pa kha shugs che ba 'ga' zhig gi thugs rgyud gdon gyi btab pa'i dbang gis/ bslab gsum gyi ngur smrig 'dzin pa khri khrag mang po dbang med du bskul nas/ dmag chen gyi g.yul bshams nas rang gi khri zhabs kyi dkyil du sleb byung dus dge 'dun gyi sde 'khrugs la thugs kyi ma longs bzhin/ pha rol gyi g.yul zlog pa la/ dpal mi'i dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan sgar thog tu phebs dgos pa byung dus yang*/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ shi gsad med pa dang*/ rke mig sgyid gsum mi gcod pa dang*/ dmag 'khrugs yun thung ba sogs kyi bka' bkod dang bcas nas byon pa yin no// de'i skabs su dmag chen gyi kha lo sgyur pa la/ sde bdag mgon po rgyal mtshan phebs pa'i tshe/ sde bdag chen po de nyid he ru ka khro chen rang gi rnam par sku 'khor mang pos mthong ba dang*/ a phyi chos kyi sgron ma chu rta sngon po la bcibs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa phyag na mda' dar bsnams pa zhig gi dmag sna 'dren pa| byis pa lo sar zhes bya bas mngon sum mthong nas rang gi nye du sogs mi mang po la gtam rgyas par bshad pa sogs kyi lo rgyus mang du yod pa rnams rje nyid kyi gsan pas/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan 'di nyid chos skyong gi byin gyis brlabs shing byas pa lam du 'gro zhing gang byas thams cad 'grub pa zhig yin gsung ngo*// de'i skabs su dmag 'khrug gi g.yul du mi shi ba byung ba la yang*/ bsngo ba rgyas par gnang ba dang*/ thugs byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas|

spyir dus kyi dmag 'khrugs zhi ba dang*/ dgos su dge 'dun gyi sde 'khrug thams cad zhi zhing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bshad sgrub thams cad rgyas pa'i smon lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pas dmag 'khrugs kyang dus ring po ma lon par zhi ba yin no// de ltar ngo bo stong nyid snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos bzhin du| rnam pa bdud log 'dren ma rungs pa thams cad lta stangs dang nus pas zil gyis non pa ni/ shing dbang gi drung du thub pa'i dbang po bdud dpung gi tshogs las rgyal ba'i mdzad pa lta bu yin no// de nas khyi lo'i nang gi sgrub sde'i spyi bsod rnams mgyogs par bsdu bar mdzad de/ sgrub mchod snga myur la grub pa mdzad nas/ dgun gyi ras chos pa stong phrag tsam la rigs dang chos kyi mtho ba'i dbon rin po ches gtso bo gnang ba'i bka' khyab kyang grub par mdzad cing*/ de rjes sku mtshams bcad rgya ma lhongs che ba yang grub par gyur pa'i rjes su/ ka tshal chos 'khor bka' bkod bzhin grub pa la thugs bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs bden tshig gnang ba'o// dus de tsam na zhing 'dir cung zad thugs bag phebs pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa ni/ thub pas kyang myang 'das kyi mdo gsungs nas sku tshe zla ba gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten 'brel ltar yin par mngon no// de nas sgrub sde'i lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi rjes mtshams/ phag lo'i sos ka mtshams bzhugs pa rnams la/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis su khrid gnang ba'i dgong re bzhin/ bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros tshig 'di 'dra re re la'ang dgos pa gal che ba zab pa'i gnad ngo mtshar can re yod pas/ da lta nged kyi bshad pa tsho la ye le ba re byed par 'dug na'ang*/ chos nyan bshad dang chos ra gcig tu yang yang 'dzom pa yang dka' bas nyams len la 'bungs dang*/ dus tshod cig na khyed rnams la yang dge sbyor da lta las khyad par du gyur pa re skye zhing*/

kho bo la yang cung zad mos su 'gro ba'i skabs shig yong ba yin/ phugs zhing khams gcig tu 'du ba'i rten 'brel che ba yin pas/ dpon slob phyogs mthun du ting nge 'dzin thun re bsgom gsung nas| khrid ma grol bar dgong re bzhin dpon slob phyogs mthun du mnyam bzhag mdzad pa dang*/ yang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa 'di/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas khyed mtshams pa rnams kyis kyang dge sbyor la 'bungs gsum thob/ dbyar mjal sogs gling gyen thur ches pas ma thub dogs pas/ dge sbyor yod pa rnams la dri ba dang dogs gcod re tsam dgos pa yod na da lta gyis/ las dang po pa rnams la khrid ma btab bar/ ngo sprod pa mtshang re che na'ang*/ gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis rlob pa'i sa yin pas/ rnam rtog gi bye brag bar chad kyi rkyen la dran pa rgyag lugs sogs/ 'di 'dra dgos gsung ba'i bka' lung dgong re bzhin gnang ba dang*/ yang mtshams la bzhugs pa'i bla ma sogs drag rim rnams la gsung sgros zab la rgya che ba nges pa can du gsungs pa ni/ bstan pa spyi la thun mong du grags pa gzhan bzhed bya ba la'ang 'di dang 'di 'dra'i rigs yin gsung ba dang*/ mdo rgyud zab mo na bzhugs kyang bod snga ma tshos zur ma thon pa/ skyob pa chen po'i thugs dgongs zab mo la shar ba'i rang bzhed ni 'di lta bu la sogs pa yin gsung ba zhib rgyas mang po phebs kyang*/ mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs pa'i bka' chems yin pa'i go ba de dus ni phal cher la ma chags/ phyis su ni chos nyan kun nges shes 'drongs nas/ phar tshur gleng slong da lta'i bar du yang byed par gyur to// de dag gi don smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sprul sku klu sgrub mgon// ljongs 'dir 'jig rten gsum mgon slar yang ni// zhal bzhes gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba la// kun dga'i nyi ma skye 'gro'i dpal du shar// rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur gsal bar mdzad// bstan dgra bdud dpung tshogs rnams zil gyis mnan// skal ldan gdul bya thar pa'i lam la bkod// zhing gzhan 'byon pa'i zhal chems shugs las gsungs// dus gsum sngon mkhyen mnga' ba khyod nyid tsam// rje btsun khyed la dad pas gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen pa'i mkha' la thugs rje'i sprin 'khrigs nas// byin rlabs char rgyun da lta phab nas kyang*// bdag sogs snyigs ma'i 'gro ba dbul phongs la// phan bde'i lo thog smin rgyas mdzad du gsol// zhes pa yang rje nyid kyi rnam par thar pa 'di nyid la rjes su yi rang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// de ltar chos kyi rje kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa thar pa'i lam ston mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba las/

sku gsung thugs kyi mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa rnams la zab don man ngag ngo sprod dang bcas pa nyams len la dril ba'i gnad/ rjes kyi mjug sdud dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang ste/ zhing khams gzhan du 'byon pa'i zhal chems shugs 'byung du bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// ༈ //rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid kyi mdzad pa bcu pa/ smon lam dang mdzad pa phrin las mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i mthar gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim zhing*/ sprul sku rang gnas su bsdus te mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i mkhyen brtse dang phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ skyob pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po 'di nyid/ zhing 'dir gdul bya dang smon lam mdzad pa phrin las rnams rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ zhing gzhan gyi 'gro don che bar dgongs nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed nas/ chos ra nam tshogs dang*/ bzhugs yul gar phebs su thugs skyo shas kyi sgo nas/ tshe la long med mi rtag 'chi tshul ston// rang re rnams kyang yun ring 'grogs par dka'// zhes sogs dang*/ ban rgan skyur yang mi sdod 'gro snying 'dod// ces sogs mang du gsungs pa dang*/ bya lo tshun nas/ da lta phan bzhugs yul gar phebs su/ 'ja' 'od 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par gzim khang gi steng na 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan zug pa dang*/ mtshan mo gzim chung gi rab gsal la 'ja' 'od rgyun ldan du zug pa dang*/ me tog gi char zim bu rgyun du 'bab pa dang*/ gzugs mi mngon pa'i skor ba byed pa'i sgra chen po rgyun du 'byung ba dang*/ ri dwags mang pos bskor ba byed pa mngon sum du mi 'ga' res mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rnams ni/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis zhing gzhan du 'gro don la spyan 'dren pa'i ltas khyad par can yin no| |de dag gi rgyu mtshan yang*/

khyi lo'i nang du bla ma nyag re rtogs ldan zer ba'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig gzhu rong bar tshigs kyi ri khrod na bzhugs pa'i sar| bud med nam mkha'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ sngo zhing mdzes pa/ rgyan du mas spras pa zhig byung ba la/ gang nas 'ongs/ de gang du 'byon sogs zhib tu dris pas| bud med de na re bdag spun bdun phrag gsum yod/ da nang rdo rje gdan nas yongs/ rdo rje gdan bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yin pa la/ phyi pas nang pa'i bstan pa nyams dma' bar byas/ du ru ka sogs kyi bstan pa la chags 'jig gi skabs su yod pas/ 'di bas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 'gro phan rdo rje gdan che bas/ 'bri gung rin po che gdan 'dren du btang pa yin te/ phebs ma gsan na bdag tsho ngo gnong ste do nub rdo rje gdan du sleb pa zhig 'gro zer ba zhig byung ngo*// yang zla ba rting ma'i tshes bcu gsum zhig la/ bud med dmar mo ras kyi ang rag gyon zhing rgyan du ma yod pa/ mkhar sil thogs pa bud med kha dog mi gcig pa lnga tshan dang*/ yang paṇa zhu dang sgom thag thogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs can gnyis dang bcas pa byung ba la/ khyed rnams gang nas byon sogs zhib tu dris pas/ nged rnams rdo rje gdan nas yin/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di gal che zhing*/ bstan pa yang mgo tshugs par 'dug na'ang*/ rdo rje gdan gal che bar byung bas 'bri gung rin po che gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa yin/ da nas rtsis pa'i zla ba hril po bcu na phebs par yod/ khyod kyang nged tsho dang sbrags nas 'gro dgos rgyu yin zer ba zhig byung 'dug pa dang*/ rtogs ldan des/ khong rang gi grwa pa dang yon bdag rnams bsdus nas/ dngos po gang yod la tshogs 'khor byas/ lung bstan byung tshul gyi kha skad rnams bshad 'dug pas/ khong rnams na re/ bla mas lha mthong 'dre mthong bshad na mi dga' zer ba byung 'dug na'ang*/ don la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan rang yin par nges te/

de nas dus mi ring bar bla ma nyag re yang mya ngan las 'das shing*/ rje nyid kyang zhing gzhan du mkha' 'gro'i gdan 'dren byung ba la zhal gyis bzhes pa'i lung bstan nges pa can yin par shes par bya'o// gzhan yang khyi lo'i sde 'khrugs kyi skabs su/ bla ma 'phags pa zer ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po/ 'phral shig nad kyis btab pa zhig yod pa de na re/ rje btsun rin po che/ khyed kyi sku tshe'i ring la dmag 'khrug mang po yong ba 'di rgyu ci lags zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ rtogs ldan 'phags pa khyod la tshe'i ring la shig nad rang yong ba ci yin gsungs pas/ sngon las yin pa 'dra zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ sngon las kyang yin las che ste/ nged kyi ring la dmag byed dgos 'ga' yong ba ni shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo gcig gi rkyen pa yin 'dug khyed la shig nad mang po yong ba ni/ las kyi sgrib pa red/ nged rang gnyis ka'i rkyen 'di/ thod pa ma bzhag bar la chad bsam pa mi 'dug gsung ngo*// rje rin po che nged rang dpon slob gnyis kyi dbu thod ci tsam thub pa lags zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas dbu thod gnyis po 'dis/ lo 'khor bsam pa mi snang*/ a cang su la yang ma 'chad cig khyod rtogs ldan yin pas grub rtags shig ston dang gsungs pas/ bla ma 'phags pas/ thugs nyams 'ur nas khru gang tsam sa las 'phags pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi de la grub rtags zer ba min/ nyams snang rlung gi yon tan yin/ de 'dras cang yong ba min gsung ba'i mod la/ rje nyid bzhugs gdan las 'phags nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la phebs nas bar snang la dal cig bzhugs dus gzims khang gi sgo khrog zer nas byung ba dang*/ bzhugs gdan la phebs nas/ 'khrul 'khor zer tsa na de 'dra yong ba yin zhes gsungs so// de'i phyi lo bla ma 'phags pa sku gshegs khar spyan chab bsil bas/ snyung g.yog pas khyed rtogs ldan yin pas ma bshum zhig/ bya bral sna mang pas bkur pa zhus yong ngo zhus pas/

nga zhag gsum bzhi tshun la 'chi ste/ mtsher ba min/ nga la rje rin po che'i bka' lung 'di bzhin gnang yod pas| rje rin po che gzhan don la phebs pa 'dug snyam pa yin gsungs pa ni/ de dus kyi 'khor rnams kyi nges pa'o// de dag ni rje rin po che rang gi gsung rjen pa la zhing gzhan du 'byon par gsungs pa yin no// yang sngon 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyis/ lcag tshan gyi tsha ru zhig gling dkyil gyi brag la btsugs nas/ shing 'dis st+wa yu dang ste'u yu nyan dus skor gcig sleb yong gsung ba dang*/ gser khang sgo bcad mar khri thog bcu gsum dus 'byon par lung bstan pa ltar/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon de nyid rang gi gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba la byon pa ni/ rje btsun kun dga' rin chen 'di nyid yin te/ khri thog bcu gsum pa yin pa dang*/ lung bstan pa'i shing de yang st+wa yu dang ste'u yu nyan par sleb cing sku mya ngan las 'da' khar shing de yang rtsa ba nas gog nas byung ba ni/ rje nyid zhing khams gzhan du 'byon pa'i ltas thun mong ma yin pa yin no// de nas phag lo lo gsar du sleb pa'i skabs su/ rje btsun 'di nyid sngar gyi lugs ltar thugs dam nyams len gyi rim pa la thugs lhag par gzhol ba'i ngang nas/ phyogs kyi dad 'dus rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhugs so// de'i tshe rje nyid kyi sku la snyun mi mnga' yang*/ gsol ja bzhes pa sogs kyang sngar bzhin mi bzhes pa dang*/ gsung 'byon pa rnams kyang gzhug thung thung gnang ba sogs sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i yid ma ches pa re sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pa sogs sku 'khor phyag g.yog pa rnams la byung yang*/ thugs cung zad rmongs pa'i ngang nas rgyu mtshan gyi dogs gcod zhu ba ma byung ba yin gsungs so// de nas phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du chab tshan la phebs pa'i thog tu/ chab grib kyi rnam pas sku khams cung zad nyog pa tsam byung ba'i dus sdings rgyal rdor 'dzin kun dga' legs pa phyag 'bul la byon/

zhag gcig gnyis song nas/ ri khrod la 'gro bar zhus pas/ nged kyi tsha chu'i ring la khyed kyang sdod/ sa cha 'di nyid dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams dag cing*/ nged rang rnams kyang dri bshad kho thag chod pa zhig byed/ mtshams pa rnams kyang 'dir bos dang*/ nga yang dga'| khong tsho rnams la'ang phan pa yin gsungs pa dang*/ chab gzims la phebs so// der dbon rin po che dang*/ rtogs ldan yang kha shas dang*/ sku rim pa rnams dang bcas pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i sar/ gsung rab kyi go don rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa dang bstun pa'i dge sbyor gyi bsgrigs rim zab la rgya che ba mang po zhig gsungs pa'i mtshams su ma ṇi'i bro brdung gi tshul du/ gar nyams gnang bzhin 'di gsungs so// rnam rtog gi ri rgyal brtan par sdod| |nyi zla skar gsum gling bzhi yongs la 'gro// 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi drung du 'dzoms pa'i smon lam yod// ces gsungs pa'i mod la yang 'di gsungs so| |lus rnam rtog gi ri rgyal lhun po khyod// tshogs rten 'brel gyi sa gzhi brtan par sdod// nged nyi zla skar gsum mi sdod 'gro// zhing gling bzhi yongs la gdan 'dren yod// gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad skad pa der// dus phyi ma'ang kho bo'i drung du mjal// a la la gnas mchog gi ya mtshan la// a la la smon lam gyi rten 'brel la// bu slob kun da lta yang ram bu khyog skal ldan tsho don nub tsam gsol ba thob// gnas ngo mtshar can ti sgro dag pa'i zhing*// ban nga yi bla ma u rgyan rje// dus rgyun du bzhugs pas nyams re dga'// bu slob ma tshor u rgyan la gsol ba thob// chab ngo mtshar can lung bstan tsha chu 'di// ban nga rang gi yum mchog phag mo yis| |sman bdud rtsi ru sbyar bas dang re spro// grwa bu slob tsho yi dam la mos gus gyis// grogs ngo mtshar can mi min mkha' 'gro ma// ban nga rang gi a phyi chos sgron ma| |grogs 'du 'bral med pa blo re bde// khyed gdul bya kun ma dang mkha' 'gros skyong*// 'khor ngo mtshar can 'dir tshogs rtogs ldan tsho// ban nga rang la dam tshig gtsang ba kun// tshe phyi ma ru 'phrad pa'i blo phugs brod// yab bka' brgyud kyi chos la 'bungs shig ang*// zhes pa la sogs bro brdung rgyun ring bar gnang bas|

sku 'khor rnams kyang the tshom gyi gzhi che bar byung yang 'di byed kyi gtol ma rnyed pa'i ngang nas 'phral du mtshe'u khar spyan drangs te/ sku rim gtos che ba btsugs rung*/ bka' lung bzang ngan gang yang ma gsung na'ang*/ sku khams dwangs pa zhig e yong bsam pa'i sku rim la dmigs pa'i 'gyed kyi bye brag nyin re bzhin byas kyang*/ dam sel can gyi 'grul pa snga rting gis rkyen ngan pa la brten nas/ khad kyis sku shed chung bar mngon pa byung bas/ sku khams 'tsho mi 'tsho the tshom skyes te/ nangs zhogs snga bar sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pas rje nyid kyi drung du byon nas 'di ltar zhus so// rje btsun chen po khyed kyi mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bya ba 'phro can du yod cing*/ khyad par gser gdugs dang*/ gser thog sogs mdzad pa'i 'phro yang 'di tsam yod/ zhing khams 'di nyid dang*/ rje btsun khyed la blo gtad cing ltos pa bcas pa'i bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa rnams la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas/ ji srid mdzad pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar zhabs pad brtan pa'i thugs mdun bka' drin skyong dgos zhus pas/ de'i dngos lan cang ma phebs/ yang zhu len gzhan ma kha shas kyi mu la/ gser khang nang ma'i thog 'phang stod dgos dang*/ 'chos dgos gang yod grub rjes/ gzim chung gi thang ka rten mchod rnams kyang der bsgrigs/ thub pa gnas bcu snga mo nas yod pa de g.yas g.yon gcig tu bsgrigs/ gsar du tsan dan las grub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis gcig na ning nas e grub bsam kyang lus pa zhig byung*/ da 'phral du tsan dan lag na gang yod dang bstun pa'i mdzad bcu 'di kha ta byed pa dang*/ bya ba 'phro can gser gdugs dang*/ gser thog 'di lus na mi yong*/ da lta phan khyed tshos gang lab thams cad grub pa yin pas/ nga'i khams kyis kha ta ma pher yang khyed kyis khur che bar gyis shig ces pa sogs gsungs pa dang*/

sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pa/ dus der thugs 'thoms pa'i ngang du lus kyang*/ rjes su dgongs pa sngon btang can gyi bka' lung rang du mngon par byung gsungs so// de nas nyer dgur sleb pa dang*/ dgu gtor rgyas pa gnang ba sogs kyang mdzad/ de nas tshes gcig nas rim pa bzhin sku khams yang khad kyis sku shed chung du song na'ang*| thugs dam gyi sgrig phyag mchod sogs kyang ma chag pa rang du mdzad/ tshes lnga'i nyin dbon rin po che dang sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pa sku mdun du bos nas bstan pa'i khur bskur ba'i bka' legs par bstsal nas/ thugs dam gtor bsngos mdzad nas chos skyong la gtad pa mdzad do// de nas tshes drug gi nyin thugs dam rim pa rnams sngar ltar mdzad pa grub rjes/ sku khams cung zad nyog pa'i tshul gyis/ thugs dam spros med 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la/ nyi ma snga phyed yan bzhugs par mdzad do// slar yang nyi ma gung la khel ba'i thun mtshams la nye ba/ dus rgyun chags kyi thugs dam grol ba'i mtshams kyi tshad de tsam ni/ seng ge'i khri'i steng du/ bla gos snam sbyar sogs kyis bklubs shing*/ bka' rtags kyi sgom zhwa yang dbu la bzhes/ phyag thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsungs so/ bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam sogs kyi mtshan nas brjod nas/ 'di skad du/ khyed rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis thog drangs ma gyur nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag par gyur cig shin tu dag par gyur cig gsungs pa'i ngang nas/ spyan bar snang la hrig hrig pa'i blta stangs mdzad cing*/ seng ge'i khri'i steng du zhabs rdo rje dkyil krung dang*/ phyag mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas/ sku drang por bsrang ste/ spyan ting nge 'dzin shin tu zhi ba'i gzigs stangs su mdzad de|

dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum pa/ me mo phag gi lo'i hor zla dgu pa'i tshes drug la/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim ste mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa yin no| |dus der zhabs drung na 'khod pa ni/ sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pa/ nang pa mgon po bkra shis pa/ gzim dpon sangs bkris dang gsum/ sgo phyin gsol dpon bsam pa don grub rnams yod pa las/ khong dpon g.yog rnams ni/ dus der rnam rtog gi 'dzin pa rang sar zhi nas 'di byed kyi snang ba gang yang ma skyes par yun ring du lus/ cung zad nas sngar ma tshor ba'i rol mo'i sgra dang*/ glu dbyangs kyi rnam pa 'dra ba dang*/ dri bzang gi ngad pa chil chil ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung ngo*// 'di yi skabs su rang sems skyo ba'i rang mdangs kyi tshig 'di smras so// thub pa'i bstan pa snyigs ma rtsod dus 'dir// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i sku// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen de// dus 'dir dag pa'i zhing du gshegs tshul bstan// gangs can ljongs 'di mun pa'i gling du gyur// zab don gnas lugs sgrub brgyud bstan pa de// yul gyi dbus su blo bur nyid du nub// gdul byar gyur pa'i bu slob thams cad kun// long ba lam mkhan dag dang bral ba 'am| |bu gcig shi ba'i ma ltar mya ngan gdungs// lus kyi zungs mi thub par sa la 'gyel// sems yid rab tu skyo ba'i smre sngags 'bod// ci bya gtol med dran pa nyams par gyur// 'di 'dra'i snang tshul bsams na snying rlung ldang*// rig pa mi zin sems ni phya ma phyo// bka' drin 'khor med rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan// mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// mya ngan sdug bsngal sol cig skyob pa rje// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i// sprul sku dag pa'i zhing du bsdud tshul des// bdag sogs las ngan skyed pa'i lus ngan 'di// mi rtag 'chi bar ston pa'i brda ston yin// don med tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng kun spangs nas// bslu med yongs 'dzin kun dga'i mtshan can la// gdung shugs drag po'i gsol ba 'debs bzhin du// gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi nyams len la| |snying nas sgom sgrub mdzad na mi legs sam// thugs bsam yang yang thongs la lha chos mdzod// ces pa 'di ni dus 'di'i skabs kyi snang tshul la bsams te rang sems skyo ba'i smre sngags kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// de ltar me phag ston zla 'bring po tha skar can gyi dkar phyogs kyi tshes drug gi snga dro'i thun gsum pa'i mtshams der dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus nas bzung ste/

tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma snga dro'i cha'i bar la/ thugs dam zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chen po gnas lugs don gyi rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i dbyings dang*/ ye shes dbyer med pa chos sku bde ba chen po'i ngang la bzhugs pa'o// de'i bar la sku'i mdangs sngar las kyang lhag pa lta bu snum zhing 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ nam mkha' ni bai ḍūrya'i rgya mtsho bzhin du sngo la dwangs shing g.ya' dag pa dang*/ sprin dang ser bu cung zad kyang med pa'i ngang nas| me tog gi char bsam gyis mi khyab pa bab pa dang*/ khyad par tshes bcu nas rgya spos kyi dri ngad zil gyis gnon pa'i dri bzang gi ngad pa sngar tshor ma myong ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bar snang thams cad rol mo'i sgra snyan yid 'phrog pas gang ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can rnams ni/ gdung mchod 'bul mkhan gyi rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ 'dan ma rtogs ldan dang*/ kong po rtogs ldan dang gsum bzhugs pa rnams la sogs pa'i der bzhugs pa thams cad kyi mngon sum du mthong zhing grub pa yin no// gdung gi drung na bzhugs pa'i rdor 'dzin grogs mched gsum po la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rang shugs kyi 'khrungs shing*/ gzigs snang ngo mtshar can byung tshul ni tshes bcu gsum gyi nub mo rdor 'dzin pa'i thugs dam gyi gzigs snang la/ seng ge'i gzugs 'gros shin tu che ba/ mdog sngo skya ba la rje nyid rigs lnga'i cod pan bzhes te bcibs nas/ chibs kha dang sku la dge 'dun mang pos bskor nas shar phyogs su byon pa gzigs so// kong po rtogs ldan la/ nam mkha' sngo dwangs sprin gzhan med pa'i dbus na/ sprin dkar la 'tsher ba'i steng du/ rje nyid dge 'dun shin tu mang bas bskor ba rol mo'i sgra snyan dang bcas bzhugs pa la/ dbu'i steng du rma bya'i sgro'i gdugs yid 'ong dar gyi sham bu sum rtsegs yod pa 'phru dang tog gser las byas pa gzigs so// bla ma 'dan ma la ni mdun ri chu 'phan dang*/

gzim chung 'phyong rtse'i bar 'ja' sna lnga zheng che bas 'brel ba la/ mtshams mtshams su 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang che ba bcu gsum bsgrigs nas 'dug pa'i gong ma'i nang du ston pa sangs rgyas gser mdog nyan thos gnyis dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor gsum bzhugs pa| de'i 'og gi 'od skor la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ bar skabs med par nyan thos dang*/ khye'u bu mo sogs rgyan bzang zhing mdzes pas gang ba/ tshes bcu gsum man nas/ tshes bco lnga'i bar de ka'i ngang du gnas so// tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma rtse shar la/ gzim chung gi nang gzhan las yangs pa'i nang du/ dge slong gi cha lugs ngur smrig can dbu reg zhabs rjen grangs med byon pa phal cher gyis spos phor thogs te/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs shin tu mang ba'i dbus su/ rje nyid na bza' chos gos mnams pa la/ dbu rgyan rigs lngas spras pa/ gzims chung gi bar snang la yun ring tsam bzhugs rjes/ bla ma 'dan ma rang la gsung gleng mang po phebs pa'i snang ba yang shar nas/ de mus 'ja' gur rim par rgyud de ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bar du rim par brgyud pa yin no// de nub srod kyi cha la'ang 'ja' gur sogs ma yal bar gzigs 'dug go/ de tshun tshes bco lnga byung ngo cog la gzim chung gi rab gsal nas/ rtogs ldan kong po'i gzigs lam du| ri bong zhig phyag grangs med 'tshal ba gzigs pa yin 'dug go// khong gsum dam tshig gtsang bas gzigs snang khyad par can byung ba de yis mtshon te skal ldan gzhan la byung ba ni brjod kyis mi langs pa yin no// bla ma 'dan ma la rje mya ngan las 'das rjes/ ti ser mtsho mchod 'bul ba la 'byon dgos par lung bstan pa ni| rje nyid zhal bzhugs pa'i dus/ phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du/ sgam po dang tsā ri sogs la sgrub pa la 'byon par zhus pas/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyod dam tshig gtsang ba'i slob ma yin pas/ re zhig thag nye 'khor du sdod/

dus babs la gnas dang ri khrod dang song chog pa yong ba yin/ yang nged kyi don phran tshegs shig bsgrub dgos 'byung ba'ang srid/ ces gsung ba la brten nas/ 'di phyogs la bzhugs rjes su rje rin po che sku mya ngan las 'das dus/ ti ser mtsho mchod dang gser 'bum bzhengs par 'byon rogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ rje nyid kyi bka' lung dran te/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas thugs kyis blangs nas ti ser byon pa yin no// de nas rje btsun dam pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid kyi snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab pa la brten pa'i sku gdung rin po che mjal mkhan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/ dam tshig gtsang mi gtsang gi dbye ba shes par dka' bas/ re zhig rin po che'i sgrom bur bzhugs su gsol nas/ dar gos kyi na bza' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bklubs pa dang*/ mdun du mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa/ bkod pa mchog tu gyur pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ dam tshig gtsang ma'i mchod 'bul ba dang bcas te/ gzim khang rang du dngul gdung rin po che ma grub bar du skal ldan gyi 'gro ba rnams phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba la sogs te bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i yul du bzhugs pa yin no// sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su/ ngo mtshar ba'i grongs rtags rang gzhan gyi skye bo kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa ni/ dgung zhag ma rdzogs kyi bar la/ gdung gi drung du mar me chung chung re res kyang nyin zhag dpag tu med pa rang 'bar la thub pa dang*/ phyogs thams cad du sa chu thams cad shin tu dros nas/ sa gzhi thams cad sngo zhing dbyar dus lta bur gyur te/ ting phor nang gi nas la chu 'thor ba rnams la'ang*/ nas kyi ljang pa sor drug lhag pa skyes pa kun gyi mig lam du mthong ba dang*/ lung pa phu mda' dag gi ba lu'i me tog dang*/ dgon pa so so'i ldum ra'i me tog la sogs te/

me tog mtha' dag rang shar du byung ste shin tu bkra bar gyur pa skye bo kun gyi mngon sum du mthong zhing*/ 'bri gung chos rje'i grongs rtags yin par kun gyi mthun grub du gyur te/ sngon shin du mi dad pa'i skye bo rnams kyang*/ sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can de rnams la/ yid lhag par dad pa'i mos gus skyes te/ sngar byas kyi las la 'gyod de bshags pa byed cing*/ phyis gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson pa sogs/ ma dad pa'i snang ba bsgyur cing*/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab pa yin no// de lta bu'i dpe gcig tsam brjod na/ 'phan yul mda'i dgon pa gsal khang dang nye ba na/ lcang sgang dbon po bya ba 'bri gung pa la dga' ldan pa'i ser dmag byas dus kyi dmag phyogs gcig gi mgo dpon byed myong ba zhig dus der rang gi bla g.yel du me tog rgya men mang po shar byung ba la/ rje nyid kyi grongs rtags su shes te/ me tog lag pas g.yabs te/ 'bri gung chos rje/ 'bri gung chos rje/ dgun grang sgang gi me tog rang shar 'di/ khyed kyi grongs rtags rang du 'dug pas/ nged mang po zhig gis sdig pa chen po bsags pa 'dra zer nas 'chi ma 'don zhing 'dug pa de'i nye skor kun gyi mthun grub la mthong zhing*/ de 'dra'i lo rgyus mang yang bri yis mi lang bas dpe tsam zhig bkod pa'o// de nas sku mya ngan las 'das rjes/ rje btsun nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ dus yun mi ring bar/ jo gdan mkhan po dgra bcom pa grags rgyal ba dpon slob bcu phrag du mas gtso mdzad pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs lnga stong tsam dang*/ skye bo 'jig rten pa'i tshogs khri phrag bco brgyad las mi nyung ba dang bcas pa rnams la/ bza' ba dang btung ba'i bye brag phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ mtho dman thams cad la gang la gang 'os kyi 'bul snod dang 'gyed kyi bye brag

sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang gser dngul la sogs te rin po che'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ gzhan yang gos dar dang*/ ja sig dang*/ go khrab dang*/ snam phrug dang*/ nas sran dang*/ rta dang*/ dre'u dang*/ mdzo pho mo dang*/ 'bri khal la sogs rkang bzhi'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'bul ba dang*| mdor na longs spyod kyi dngos pos sa gzhi thams cad gang ba tsam sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i dpal 'byor la 'gran par nus pa'i longs spyod rang gzhan kun gyi blor mi shong ba'i rgyu dngos bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'bul ba dang*/ sbyin gtong tshogs gsog rnams kyang*/ sngar gyi lugs srol bzang po las kyang ches cher lhag pa'i sgo nas| rang gzhan gyi skye bo thams cad kyi re ba 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor gyi tshim par mdzad de/ snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs thams cad du g.yo bar mdzad pa'o// de nas dge 'dun stong phrag phyed gsum tsam gyis/ re zhig gi bar la mchod pa rgyun ma chad par phul zhing*/ de rnams la yang zhabs tog dang 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad de/ rgyas par brjod kyis mi lang ba yin no// gzhan yang ti se la gser 'bum bzhengs pa/ mtsho ma pham la gdung mchod/ bal po shing kun la gser gdugs 'gel ba/ gnas gsum la tshogs 'khor 'gyed dang bcas pa/ gzhan 'dir phyogs kyi dgon pa so so la/ mang ja skol ba dang 'gyed kyi bye brag la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa myur bar grub pa sogs brjod kyi mi lang ba yod kyang 'dir ma bris so// rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel ngo mtshar can byon tshul ni/ sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu nang ring bsrel dang rten gyi phung por gyur kyang rnam pa sku'i dbyibs ma zhig par gos dar phun sum tshogs pa'i na bza' dang bcas/ dngul gdung bkra shis 'od 'bar rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ bzo dang bkod pa'i mchog tu gyur pa/

rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas spras pa/ blta bas chog mi shes pa'i nang du bdag sogs 'gro ba'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du bzhugs su gsol ba yin no// thugs dam 'od gsal las grol dus kyi/ byang sems dkar dmar dang*/ chab ser gyi rnam pa cung zad byung ba la kong po rtogs ldan gyis rtsam pa dang*/ sman sna dang*/ spos sna gang 'dzom rnams byang sems dkar dmar chab ser dang bcas pa bsres nas 'dam 'bag byas te/ g.yang ru zer ba'i phyag g.yog pa zhig yod pa la'ang byin rlabs de nas mtshon pa sbyin nas/ de lhag la khong rang gi byin rlabs ril bu bcos pa'i nang du dung g.yas 'khyil kha dog shel gyi mdog lta bu/ skye mched dod la mdzes shing yid 'phrog pa gsum byon pa yin no// g.yang ru'i byin rlabs kyi rten 'dam de/ phyed bshags la btang ba la yang*/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyed bshags nang du/ dung g.yas 'khyil ya mtshan pa re re ste gnyis byon zhing*/ de lta bu'i dung g.yas 'khyil lnga byon pa ni/ mngon sum du gyur pa da lta mig lam du mjal rgyu yod pa mthun grub tu gyur pa yin no// gzhan yang kong po rtogs ldan gyi phyag gi byin rlabs de las cung zad re mched pa rnams la yang*/ ring bsrel byon pa dang*/ byin rlabs de'i mu la gdung tsha btab pa la'ang ring bsrel 'khrungs pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo// gzhan yang rje nyid kyi gzim mal gser sku sku tshad las che ba/ nang bzhugs la klu rgyal gyis phul ba'i sangs rgyas kyi tshems mche ba g.yas pa bzhugs pa'i sku 'bag ngo mtshar can dang*/ dar sku byin rlabs can du ma dang*/ sgo mang gi gser gdugs dang gser thog la sogs pa rgyu bzang zhing bzo'i bkod pa sngar yod rnams las khyad par du gyur pa sogs rje btsun nyid kyi mdzad pa'i rjes kyi bya ba rnams legs par grub pa yin no// de ltar rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba mtha' dag bsgrubs pa'i kun gyi gtso bo ni/

rgyal ba nyid kyi rigs dang chos kyi rgyal tshab dam pa/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed/ lung rtogs mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag sa gsum 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ gsang chen rigs brgya'i bdag nyid/ khams gsum chos kyi rje rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid kyis legs par bsnams shing*/ khyad par rje btsun dam pa kun dga'i mtshan can de nyid dang por zhal bzhugs dus kyi zhabs tog bar du bstan pa skyong ba'i phrin las kyi grogs dan/ tha mar sku mya ngan las 'das rjes dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba mtha' dag legs par sgrub par byed pa'i khur chen bsnams pa'i gtso bo/ skye ba dang tshe rabs du ma nas rje nyid dang smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar ba'i skyes mchog bstan pa'i bya ba rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rlabs po che sgrub pa'i blo stobs dang ldan pa/ ci mdzad yon tan du mthong ba'i mos gus tshad bzung med pa'i sgo nas ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i thugs kyi sras mchog rje nyid kyi dpal ye shes mgon pos byin gyis brlabs par lung bstan cing*/ bstan dgra mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zil gyis gnon par nus pa'i mthu stobs dang ldan pa'i rje blon chen po/ dpal mi'i dbang po sde bdag mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ khur shin tu che bar bzhes pa'i sgo nas/ rje nyid kyi mdzad pa'i phrin las tha ma dgongs rdzogs kyi bar thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa mthar phyin du bsgrubs shing*/ grub par mdzad pa yin no// de ltar rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa/ thar pa'i lam ston mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba las/ smon lam dang mdzad pa phrin las mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i mthar/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim zhing*/ sprul sku rang gnas su bsdus te/ mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// ༈ //de ltar rje btsun dam pa kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po 'di nyid zhing 'dir 'gro ba'i don la byon pa'i mdzad pa ni/

thog mar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te 'gro ba'i don du sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa dang*/ gzhon nu nyid nas mtshan brjod rang shar du 'don pa dang*/ byis pa'i tshogs la chos gsung ba dang*| sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sogs pa'i zhal gzigs ma thag ting 'dzin khyad par can rang rdol la 'khrungs pa dang*/ yongs 'dzin gyi bla ma dam pa bcu phrag bsten tshul dang*| dam pa rnams kyi drin las thob pa'i gdams ngag thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ rtags bcu dang yon tan brgyad la sogs pa nyams rtogs khyad par can mngon du gyur tshul dang*/ thub dbang dang*/ bde mchog la sogs pa yi dam dpag tu med pa zhal gzigs pa dang*/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal gzigs nas phrin las rtsol med du sgrub pa dang*/ lha'i me tog rgyun du 'thor ba dang*/ mkha' 'gros bya rgod du sprul nas chos nyan pa dang*/ ri dwags mang pos skor ba byed pa dang*/ me dang chu la sogs pa'i 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad bden stobs brjod pa tsam gyis zlog par nus pa dang*/ nad pa gdon gyis nyen pa la spyi bor phyag bzhag pa tsam gyis bde bar gyur pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur dang*/ bkra shis sgo mang khyad par can la sogs pa sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar can bsam gyis mi khyab pa grangs las 'das pa bzhengs pa dang*/ 'bri gung byang chub gling du sgrub sde thar pa'i gru chen btsugs pa dang*/ thugs rje'i nus pas bstan dgra ma rungs pa thams cad zil gyis mnan te phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ klu'i rgyal po rgyal ba thod dkar la sogs pa'i klu rgyal rnams kyis kyang bka' bsgrubs shing dgos 'dod 'bul ba dang*/ u rgyan rin po che las chos dngos su gsan cing lung ston pa dang*/ u rgyan gyi bka' srung rnams kyis kyang*/ dngos su bka' sgrub pa dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod pa dang*/

las dag pa'i snang ngor nam mkha' la rdo rje dkyil krung mdzad pa sogs grub rtags kyi mtshan ma mngon sum du ston pa dang*/ zhing 'dir gdul bya dang smon lam gyi mdzad pa phrin las rnams rdzogs pa'i mthar/ bu slob rnams la skyo shas nges 'byung skyed pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rnyed par dka' ba'i 'du shes skyed pa dang*/ skyes bu le lo can rnams chos la bskul ba'i brtson 'grus kyi lcag 'debs pa'i phyir mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa dang*/ de'i tshe me tog gi char dang dgun gyi dus yin yang sa chu rab tu dros nas dbyar gung chen lta bur gyur pa dang*| sku'i byang sems dkar dmar dang chab ser las dung g.yas 'khyil dang ring bsrel ngo mtshar can dpag tu med pa byon pa la sogs pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di dag la legs par bsams te zhib tu rgyas par brjod na/ sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs lta bu zhig yong ba 'dug na'ang*/ dus snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams dman zhing blo chung ba rnams kyi blor mi chud pa'i skyon du 'gyur bar dogs nas/ so so skye bo'i snang tshul dang bstun te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa mdor sdus tsam brjod pa la lhag chad nor 'khrul byung na dam pa rnams la bzod par gsol lo// de ltar snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ chos kyi rje kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa/ snyan ngag tshig gi sdeb sbyor dam pos ma bcings par/ bla ma dam pa'i yon tan rang lugs su gsal bar ston pa'i me long*/ gang gis mthong ba dang thos pa tsam gyis rje btsun nyid la dad pa'i spu long g.yos te/ dkar po'i sa bon skrun pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi zhing sa dam par gyur pa/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams la srid zhi'i dpal 'byor rgyun mi 'chad pa stsol bar mdzad pa'i dge legs kyi dga' ston chen por gyur pa'i rnam par thar pa/

thar pa'i lam ston mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ rje rang gis mdzad pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar dang*/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i dbon rin po ches mdzad pa'i rje btsun nyid kyi rnam thar tshig bcad du mdzad pa dang*/ bka' rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar tshig bcad kha skong dang bcas pa dang*/ mkhas grub chen po 'bri gung ras chen pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar chen mo dang*/ dpal mi'i dbang po sde bdag mgon po rgyal mtshan pa'i phyag nas byung ba'i zin bris kyi shog sgril rnams dang*/ nang so mgon po bkra shis pa la sogs pa sku 'khor ba yid ches pa 'ga' dang 'ga' la brtags shing dpyad de mthun grub du gyur pa rnams dang*/ rang gis mngon sum du mthong ba dang thos pa rnams gong 'og ma log par/ rang bzo dang rdzun tshig gi dri ma spangs te/ dbang phyug ces pa me mo glang gi lo'i hor zla brgyad pa'i dkar phyogs la/ dpal mi'i dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/ nang so mgon po bkra shis pa la sogs te/ rje nyid kyi zhabs 'bring ba 'ga' dang 'gas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rje btsun nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi myang zhing zhabs pad spyi bos len pa'i ri khrod pa/ mdo rgyud la sbyangs pa cung zad byas shing*| bka' brgyud rin po che'i byin rlabs kyi bcud kyi legs par mtsho ba'i mdo sde rab 'byams pa blo gros rgya mtshos/ 'bri gung klung shod kyi cha lag zu re bon grong gi dben gnas nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ rnam thar phyi nang gsang gsum thams cad phyogs gcig tu sdebs shing legs par sbyar ba 'di re shig rdzogs so// e ma ho/ chos sku mnyam nyid ngang las ma g.yos bzhin// longs sku sgyu ma'i gar gyis 'gro ba 'dren// sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa'i li tsa bī// 'phags yul rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab klu sgrub mgon// gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas grub rin chen dpal// deng sang 'di na kun dga' rin chen zhes// snyan pa'i ba dan sa gsum g.yo ba'i dpal// mkhas shing grub pa'i gtsug rgyan 'di nyid kyi// bsam yas mdzad mchog ngo mtshar rmad byung gi// ye shes chen po'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa rnams// sa gnas sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis kyang*// ji bzhin ma lus brjod par mi nus na// bdag 'dra blo rmongs byis pa'i sdeb sbyor du// legs par rtsom pa shin tu dka' na'ang*// smon lam las 'phros rje btsun mchog de yis// brtse bas rjes su bzung ba'i rten 'brel las// rang rang skal ba'i mthong tshul tsam nyid kyi// rnam thar legs bshad yon tan 'dab stong can// tshig don bzang po sbrang rtsi dgos pas brgyan// byin rlabs zil mngar chags pa'i ge sar 'dzum// skal ldan 'dod dgu sbyin pa'i dpag bsam du// phan par 'gyur phyir dad gus dbang gis bkod// de las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba yis// bshad sgrub bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu sku khams bzang ba dang*// bdag gzhan ma lus tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang nas// kun gyis rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog
/'dis kyang bstan dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig// /maṅgalaṃ//
